company_name: Shanghai Laser Bonding Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides advanced bonding solutions crucial for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in advanced packaging and Chiplet technology.
summary: Shanghai Laser Bonding Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced bonding solutions within the semiconductor value chain, focusing on Die-to-Wafer and Wafer-to-Wafer bonding technologies. Their equipment supports the industrialization of Chiplet technology, offering both temporary and permanent bonding solutions for the advanced packaging industry.
